downloadIntro.zh: Windows 版已更新至 v1.59.50，Mac 版当前为 v1.59.30。请选择与你的电脑匹配的安装包。
downloadIntro.en: Windows is now v1.59.50; the current Mac release is v1.59.30. Choose the installer that matches your computer.

summary.zh: 适用于常见的 Intel 与 AMD 电脑，提供标准安装程序。
summary.en: For common Intel and AMD PCs, delivered as a standard installer.

summary.zh: 适用于 Apple 芯片 Mac，以 DMG 磁盘映像安装。
summary.en: For Apple silicon Macs, delivered as a DMG disk image.

highlights.zh: 画线警报、碰线开仓、碰线平仓：在趋势线、射线、水平线等画线上右键，选「添加警报…（Alt+A）」「碰线开仓」或「碰线平仓」，在点击处设置。价格碰到线时按设定提醒并暂停、开仓或平仓；线尾的小标记可以暂停、修改或删除；回放倒退到触发之前会自动恢复。目前用于训练图表上本品种的窗格。
highlights.en: Line alerts and line-touch orders: right-click a trend line, ray, horizontal line or similar drawing and choose Add alert… (Alt+A), Open on touch or Close on touch, then set it up where you clicked. When price touches the line it alerts and pauses, opens or closes as set. A small mark at the line's end lets you pause, edit or delete it, and stepping replay back before the trigger restores it. Available on the training chart's own-instrument panes.

highlights.zh: 国内期货下单板：期货训练的下单面板改为对手价、排队价、最新价、市价、指定价、条件六种价格方式，可设超价跳数，显示模拟的卖一、买一，「高级」里可设追单。平多、平空也按所选价格方式成交，挂出的平仓单会冻结手数；持仓表增加「可平」列，持仓分今、昨显示。上期所、能源中心默认先平今，其他交易所先开先平。
highlights.en: China futures order board: the futures training order panel now offers six price modes (opposite, queue, last, market, specified and conditional), with extra ticks, a simulated best bid and ask, and order chasing under Advanced. Close Long and Close Short follow the chosen price mode, and resting close orders lock their lots. Positions gain a Closable column and show today's and earlier lots. SHFE and INE close today's lots first by default; other exchanges close the oldest first.

highlights.zh: 数字键 1–9 按工具栏上的顺序切换周期。
highlights.en: Keys 1–9 switch timeframes in toolbar order.

highlights.zh: 快捷键调整：交易与历史列表由 1 改为 Q，下单面板由 Q 改为 A，历史由 A 改为 Z。自己改过的快捷键不受影响。
highlights.en: Hotkeys moved: trades and history list from 1 to Q, order panel from Q to A, History from A to Z. Hotkeys you customized stay as they are.

highlights.zh: 自定义指标卡死保护：Pine 脚本一次计算超过 3 秒、JS 超过 2 秒就停下，图例显示「运行超时」；上次因指标卡死关掉的，下次启动先暂停该存档的自定义指标，点一下即可恢复。
highlights.en: Custom indicator hang guard: a Pine script stops after 3 seconds of one calculation and a JS indicator after 2 seconds, and the legend shows Timed out. If the app was closed because an indicator hung, that session's custom indicators start paused next time and resume with one click.

highlights.zh: 画线的显示周期：每次选择都完整替换上一次的设置；在别的周期上设的范围会写明是哪个周期。
highlights.en: Drawing visibility by timeframe: each choice fully replaces the previous one, and a range set on another timeframe names that timeframe.

highlights.zh: 强平：K 线回放时，爆仓按价格穿过强平线的位置平仓，不再按整根 K 线的最高或最低价平，账户不会再被打成负数。
highlights.en: Stop-out: during bar replay a margin call now closes where price crosses the stop-out line, not at the bar's high or low, so the account no longer goes negative.

highlights.zh: 按名义本金百分比收手续费的外汇、加密货币存档，当天平仓会多收巨额手续费。
highlights.en: FX and crypto sessions with a percentage-of-notional fee were overcharged when a position was closed the same day.

highlights.zh: 把止盈、止损线拖到还没越过现价的位置，松手后会被设在现价外一跳、下一根就触发；现在保持原来的设置不变。
highlights.en: Dragging a take-profit or stop-loss line short of the current price set it one tick past the market, so it triggered on the next bar. It now keeps the previous setting.

highlights.zh: 退出回测或账单回放后，训练的报价变成 0；MT4 关一夜后重新打开，图上缺一段 K 线；以及几处挂单、下载提示、逐笔回放和界面文字的问题。
highlights.en: Training quotes read 0 after leaving a backtest or statement replay; reopening MT4 after a night left a gap of missing bars; plus fixes to pending orders, download messages, tick replay and interface text.
